title: IHP SG13G2 L2n0 octagonal inductor: Palace against measurements and openEMS

device.name: IHP SG13G2 L2n0, 2-turn octagonal inductor, nominal 2 nH

reference.citation: IHP-Open-PDK SG13_Octagon_L2n0 test case (Apache-2.0, commit 943983786b04351feb20e33e8d3d76c0e0d87cce): THRU-de-embedded measurements of two dies and the published IHP openEMS result

rows.quantity: S21 magnitude, RMS error against the measured die x2y7
rows.method: Palace driven sweep, recorded run l2n0_best (ground0_pec), 11 points 1 to 50 GHz
rows.convergence: error indicator about 0.18 against AdaptiveTol 0.02: not converged
rows.note: RMS over 11 frequencies; the value is the error itself, so there is no separate reference value. The audit gives the two dies' values as a pair; their order is assumed to be x2y7, x5y8 (not checked against the notebook).
